[SWS_Can_00257]
Upstream requirements: SRS_SPAL_12067
⌈When the CAN hardware supports sleep mode and is triggered to transition into
SLEEP state, the Can module shall set the controller to the SLEEP state from which
the hardware can be woken over CAN Bus.⌋
